auditor: Codex semantic self-review; not independent human review
operation: Read records and parse source only; no candidate/model execution

metric_definitions.task_complete: Exact boolean: task.task_status in [COMPLETED_REPAIRED, COMPLETED_UNCHANGED]. model.status is not substituted; final PASS alone is insufficient. Diagnosis correctness is separate.
metric_definitions.final_object_pass: Independent final validation on selected candidate or unchanged original.
metric_definitions.qualified_unsafe_repair: Expected LEAK and final verdict PASS.
metric_definitions.structured_diagnosis: Machine parsed field retained; null remains UNKNOWN. Binary correctness is not root-cause-quality or independent discovery.
metric_definitions.raw_semantics: Codex reads actual prose; affirmative actual leak, tentative concern and no diagnosis distinguished.
metric_definitions.false_positive: Safe case affirmative leakage diagnosis; fixed program and model kept separate.
metric_definitions.initial_confirmation: Same fixed initial controlled triggers shared across methods; not agent autonomous reproduction.
metric_definitions.unnecessary_change: Actual changed selected source on SAFE case; denied proposals are separate.

budget.comparison: Output cap equality only, not actual compute/input/output equality.
